name: Atelier Wool Coat
description: A sculptural double-faced wool coat cut from a single length of Italian cloth. Unlined, hand-finished, and built to hold its architecture season after season.
care: Dry clean only. Store on a broad hanger.

story.heading: One cloth, no lining
story.body: The Atelier Coat is engineered from a double-faced textile so both surfaces are finished. There is no lining to hide behind — only precise seams and a silhouette that falls exactly where it should.

reviews.name: Marguerite L.
reviews.title: The weight is extraordinary
reviews.body: It drapes like a sculpture and keeps its shape all day. Worth every cent.

reviews.name: Ines V.
reviews.title: Timeless
reviews.body: I have three coats and reach for this one every time.

name: Silk Column Dress
description: A bias-cut sandwashed silk dress that moves like water. Minimal seaming, a low back, and a hem that pools with intention.
care: Dry clean or gentle hand wash cold.

story.heading: Cut on the bias
story.body: Bias construction lets the silk find the body rather than resist it. Every panel is placed at 45 degrees so the dress falls in a continuous, liquid line.

reviews.name: Sofia R.
reviews.title: Poetry
reviews.body: Wore it to a gallery opening and did not stop getting compliments.

name: The Structured Blazer
description: A sharp single-breasted blazer with a softly padded shoulder and a nipped waist. Tailored to be worn open or closed.

reviews.name: Thea M.
reviews.title: My uniform now
reviews.body: The shoulder line is perfect. Bought it in both colors.

name: Featherweight Cashmere Knit
description: A whisper-light cashmere sweater knitted on a fine gauge for a second-skin drape. The kind of knit you live in.

story.heading: Grade-A, only
story.body: We source only the longest fibres from the underbelly of Mongolian goats. Longer fibres mean a softer hand and a knit that resists pilling for years.

reviews.name: Camille D.
reviews.title: Cloud-soft
reviews.body: Softer than knits twice the price.

name: Nocturne Tailored Suit
description: A two-piece suit cut from a high-twist wool that travels beautifully. A modern lapel, a clean shoulder, and trousers with a gentle taper.

story.heading: Built to travel
story.body: High-twist yarns spring back from a suitcase and shrug off a full day of wear. This is tailoring designed for the moving life.

reviews.name: Julian P.
reviews.title: Impeccable cut
reviews.body: Needed almost no alterations. The fabric is exceptional.

name: City Overcoat
description: A clean-lined overcoat that reads equally well over a suit or a knit. Raglan sleeves keep the shoulder soft and easy.

reviews.name: Marcus T.
reviews.title: Great everyday coat
reviews.body: Warm without being bulky. Wish it came in navy.

name: Raw Selvedge Jacket
description: A raw Japanese selvedge denim jacket that ages to your life. Copper hardware, a boxy modern cut, and a hand that softens beautifully.

reviews.name: Devon K.
reviews.title: Fades gorgeously
reviews.body: Six months in and the whiskering is unreal.

name: Structured Leather Tote
description: A vegetable-tanned leather tote that holds its shape and holds your day. Roomy, unfussy, and made to patina.

story.heading: It gets better
story.body: Vegetable tanning uses no heavy chemicals, so the leather breathes and darkens with handling. Your tote becomes a record of where you have been.

reviews.name: Priya N.
reviews.title: The only bag I carry
reviews.body: Fits everything and looks better every month.

name: Acetate Sunglasses
description: Hand-polished Italian acetate frames with mineral glass lenses. A softened rectangle that flatters most faces.

name: Minimalist Automatic Watch
description: A quietly confident automatic watch with a sapphire crystal and an exhibition caseback. Slim enough to slide under a cuff.

story.heading: Mechanical, always
story.body: No battery, no waste — just a self-winding movement that runs on the motion of your day. A small object built to outlive its owner.

reviews.name: Oscar B.
reviews.title: Punches far above its price
reviews.body: Looks like something four times the cost.

name: Oversized Cashmere Scarf
description: A generous double-faced cashmere scarf that doubles as a wrap. Woven in Scotland on heritage looms.
care: Dry clean or hand wash cold.

reviews.name: Anaïs G.
reviews.title: Enormous and cozy
reviews.body: Wrap it twice and it feels like a blanket.

name: Fluid Tailored Trouser
description: A high-waisted trouser with a fluid drape and a pressed crease. Formal enough for the office, easy enough for Sunday.

reviews.name: Rebecca S.
reviews.title: Beautiful drape
reviews.body: Runs slightly long — I hemmed them.
